title: 第23章 管你这啊那都给我死第24章 一波暴富
content_zh:
深山荒谷。
林木折倒，乱石纷飞。
肃杀之气中，数道身影相互对峙。
谷底之下，一人身高近丈，手持一杆一丈三尺大枪喷吐金色气流，上身裸露，气息悍然，胸口却残缺了大半血肉，显露出里面淡金色肋骨。
滴滴血液砸在脚下，炙热气息，将四周草木炙烤的化作焦黑。
在他身后，站着一娇媚女子。
女子手持焦褐琵琶，微微低头，双眼缠着漆黑布条，神情冰冷，身上细纱长袍随风而动，露出下方的白嫩赤足吸人目光。
两人上方，三人身穿同款血袍，双眸泛红，气息阴冷邪异，呈现品字形，将一男一女围在谷底。
粗重呼吸，回荡谷底。
薛天霸感受着身体内已然不多的罡气，挥枪指向围着他们的三人：“尔等莫非真要与我薛家为敌！”
领头血袍男子，冷冷一笑：“薛公子说笑了，你身后女子，抢夺了我血煞门的宝物，留下她，你自然可以离开。”
另一血袍男，语气更加不客气：“英雄救美的前提，是量力而行，薛天霸，要不是看在你是薛家人的面子上，你以为你这废物能活到现在！”
说着，他还舔了舔自己指甲上残留的肉丝，血色双眸中满是戏谑贪婪。
闻言，谷底的薛天霸心中气急。
他既恼怒这三人不给面子，又后悔自己一时起了色心，无端介入他人因果。
血煞门的人，是出了名的不讲信誉。
自己现在退，也未必能活下来。
现在弄得进退两难。
就在他纠结之时，身后女子，突然抬起头，面朝谷口北面，同时指尖轻弹。
琵琶奏响。

清脆声荡漾。
位于谷顶的三人，若有所觉，回头看去。
只见前方山林，有白色残影，带着一股切割一切的锋芒之势，疾驰而来。
沿途一切，纷纷被无形之力切割，树挡裂树，石挡碎石。
“这是势？”
领头血袍男脸色大变。
他没有丝毫犹豫，浑身血色煞气裹挟，化作血色残影，就想要往流川县的方向遁逃。
另外两人，也被吓了一跳。
势！
不可抵挡！
默契之下。
两人一左一右，跟着分散而逃。
只是，已经晚了。
下一刻。
低沉之声，从百米之外传来，回荡四周：“拔剑术！”
声音由远及近。
content_en:
Deep mountains and deserted valleys.
The trees fell down and rocks flew.
In the chilling atmosphere, several figures faced each other.
At the bottom of the valley, a man was nearly ten feet tall. He was holding a large gun that was one foot and three feet in his hand and spitting out golden air. His upper body was exposed and his breath was fierce. However, most of the flesh and blood on his chest was missing, revealing the light golden ribs inside.
Drops of blood hit his feet, and the hot breath turned the surrounding vegetation into scorched black.
Behind him, stood a charming woman.
The woman held a burnt brown pipa, lowered her head slightly, her eyes were wrapped with dark cloth strips, her expression was cold, her fine gauze robe moved with the wind, revealing the white and tender bare feet underneath, attracting attention.
Above the two people, three people were wearing the same blood robes, their eyes were red, and their auras were cold and evil. They were in the shape of a pin, surrounding a man and a woman at the bottom of the valley.
Heavy breathing, echoing at the bottom.
Xue Tianba felt that there was not much Gang Qi in his body, and pointed his gun at the three people surrounding them: "Do you really want to be the enemy of my Xue family!"
The leading man in blood robe smiled coldly: "Master Xue is joking. The woman behind you has robbed the treasure of my Blood Demon Sect. If you keep her, you can leave."
Another man in a blood-robed man's tone was even more unkind: "The prerequisite for a hero to save a beauty is to act according to his ability. Xue Tianba, if it weren't for the fact that you are a member of the Xue family, do you think you, a loser, can survive until now!"
As he spoke, he licked the remaining strands of flesh on his nails, his blood-red eyes full of teasing greed.
Hearing this, Xue Tianba at the bottom of the valley felt furious.
He was angry at the three people for not giving them face, and regretted that he had become lustful for a moment and intervened in the cause and effect of others for no reason.
People from the Blood Evil Sect are notoriously dishonest.
If he retreats now, he may not be able to survive.
Now we are in a dilemma.
Just when he was struggling, the woman behind him suddenly raised her head, facing the north of the valley entrance, and flicked her fingertips.
The pipa plays.
The crisp sound ripples.
The three people at the top of the valley looked back if they felt something.
I saw a white afterimage in the forest ahead, galloping towards me with a sharp edge that cut through everything.
Everything along the way was cut by invisible forces. Trees blocked trees and rocks blocked gravel.
"Is this momentum?"
The face of the leading man in blood robe changed greatly.
He didn't hesitate at all, his whole body was covered with bloody evil energy, turned into a bloody afterimage, and wanted to escape in the direction of Liuchuan County.
The other two people were also shocked.
Potential!
Unstoppable!
Under tacit understanding.
The two of them, one on the left and one on the right, scattered and fled.
But, it's too late.
The next moment.
A low voice came from a hundred meters away and echoed around: "Draw the sword!"
The sound moves from far to near.
